description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R percentage for different LLaMA models with varying SFT configurations. The horizontal axis represents the LLaMA models, labeled as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10. Each model is associated with a group of four bars, representing different SFT configurations: "no SFT" (blue with white diagonal stripes), "+ SFT on D0" (yellow with horizontal stripes), "+ SFT on D0, D1" (purple with white diagonal stripes), and "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2" (red with diagonal stripes). The bar heights for "no SFT" are approximately 68, 70, and 81 for the three models, respectively, while the heights for "+ SFT on D0" are around 67, 74, and 82, for "+ SFT on D0, D1" are about 80, 85, and 83, and for "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2" are approximately 84, 81, and 84. The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order, but the groups are arranged in ascending order of model size. No bars are visually emphasized.
